protocol.candidate_policy: For every unordered raw-track pair with temporal overlap, use the final common frame and audit both directions with the frozen directional planner. Keep every executable direction; no GT or utility value participates in candidate construction or filtering.
protocol.scope: Independent-domain directional local counterfactual teacher bank.
protocol.teacher: GT is used only after candidate construction to compute dense local association and local IDTP counterfactual targets.
